import subprocess
# Reset to just before m2, keeping only the amended m1
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'reset', '--soft', 'c32af20'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Reset:", result.stdout if result.stdout else result.stderr)

# Now remove the old m1 and m2/m3 commits
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Commits after reset:")
print(result.stdout)
